title: Alvin College
subtitle: New mexico July 11-14, 2026
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Alvin College. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel Day to  New Mexico & Texas Tech University

  • Travel to New Mexico!
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Self-Guided Tour of Texas Tech University
  • Visit the Buddy Holly Center
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)
 

Day 2: University of New Mexico & Old Town Albuquerque Ghost Tours

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Departure to Albuquerque 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Self-Guided Tour of University of New Mexico 
  • Visit the Albuquerque Museum 
  • Dinner Allocation 
  • Old Town Albuquerque Ghost Tours
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: New Mexico State University & Meow Wolf- House of Eternal Return

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of New Mexico State University with Admissions Session
  • Visit Santa Fe Plaza 
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Visit Meow Wolf- House of Eternal Return 
  • Visit the Museum of Indian Arts & Culture 
  • Take the Sandia Peak Tramway
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 4: Departure for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Depart for Home
  • Lunch and Dinner Allocations
introHeading: Alvin College, get ready for an unforgettable New Mexico adventure in 2026! ☀️
introText: From historic plazas to breathtaking desert views, this Santa Fe and Albuquerque experience brings culture, creativity, and discovery to life at every turn. Students will explore vibrant Southwestern traditions at the Santa Fe Plaza, experience immersive art at Meow Wolf, visit inspiring museums, and take in stunning mountain scenery on the Sandia Peak Tramway. With meaningful college campus visits and unique local experiences, this trip offers the perfect blend of learning, culture, and adventure—an unforgettable journey your students will never forget!
